caption: The drawing depicts a single object that resembles an antique oil lamp with a large, round base that tapers upward into a narrower neck, then flares slightly at the top, supporting a fitted lid with a small knob. The lamp has an elongated spout extending horizontally to the right side, ending in a small, circular opening. A large, curved handle extends upward from the back of the lamp, looping in an arc above the lid before terminating in a circular ring. The entire illustration is in grayscale, rendered with pencil or graphite, utilizing shading to emphasize the three-dimensional form of the object. The lamp is centered on a light, off-white background that is bordered by a simple pencil-drawn rectangular frame. The artist's name, "IRVING D. GEHAN," is faintly inscribed in small letters in the lower right corner beneath the frame.
title: Lamp
